ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) across approximately 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are limited to localized clusters at the distal tips and scattered micro-flecks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-grey to black pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white circular clusters are mapped to the distal lateral tips. Sparse white micro-pixels are distributed along the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree internal angle; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern featuring sharp peaks and shallow valleys across the entire trailing boundary from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve along the trailing edge resulting in acute, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer margins of both the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear white disruptions are visible: a prominent diagonal mark on the upper-left lobe and multiple short, horizontal rake-like marks on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral encrustation and associated scarring localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Occlusion of the lower central peduncle area due to high-intensity pixel clusters representing turbulent water spray/foam.
